cut_rhythm.pattern: Three scenes: 1.47 s dark split-flap hook, one 15.68 s light UI-demo scene carrying most of the story through internal element animation, whip transition at 17.15 s into a 7.85 s light closing scene (11 hours -> 10 seconds, brand). Short-long-medium rhythm.

shots.camera_angle: Flat-on UI / product-demo graphics, no live footage; cards tilt slightly in perspective and float.
shots.composition: Centred single focal element on a mostly empty frosted gradient: input pill at about 50-55% height (9.3 s), trip card centred (10-15 s), stacked booking cards (14.8 s), strike-through number at 30-35% height (21.1 s).

moves: floating card drift with slight perspective tilt

elements.easing: spring / overshoot for cards and pills; fast ease-out for typing and counters

text.role: kinetic captions + UI labels + hero numbers
text.weight: bold for headline lines (Poppins-like geometric sans), medium for UI labels, monospace caps for the flap-board hook
text.case: mono caps in hook ('WHERE TO NEXT?'), sentence case elsewhere
text.size_class: headline about 4-5% of frame height, hero numbers (11 hours) larger
text.animation_in: split-flap letter flip (0.7 s), typed caret, search-tag chips pop in, blue gradient word reveal 'where, when, how much.' (9.3 s), letter morph / blur-in on 'Fairwind' (21.8 s)

grade.look: Hook: black with off-white and orange-coral accent. Body: light frosted pastel gradient (cool pale blue to warm peach, #ECECEE / #ECEFF4 / #F1E9E4), soft drop shadows, brand colours blue (#3B82F6 style), coral-orange, green, yellow, purple chips. Clean flat UI look, no film grade.

layout.safe_zones: Captions and cards sit in the 25-60% band, inside the safe area.
layout.framing_notes: Whole frame is the cropped inner edited video (screen-in-scene reel, monitor ignored). Black frame in the collage after 21 s is collage padding / empty tile, not video (the magenta empty tile in collage_events likewise).

recipe.notes: Needs: split-flap board component, search-chip pop-ins (tags like 'lisbon in 3 days'), counter '1_', input pill with three tokens (Lisbon / 3 days / $800 + mic), map trip card with timer chip (3.1 s -> 10.0 s), boarding-pass + hotel + dinner cards with blue checkmarks, listening voice pill with waveform, strike-through '11 hours' with orange line and dotted '10 s' build, brand pill with letter blur-in + three black tiles.
